mediaFolder.title: Folder for Znada's files
mediaFolder.sub: Where pictures downloaded or added one by one are kept. Photos from watched folders stay where they are.
mediaFolder.moveBack: Move back to the app's folder
mediaFolder.pickTitle: Choose a folder for Znada's files
mediaFolder.confirmBody: {count} files, {size}, will be copied to {path}, checked one by one, and only then removed from the old place.
mediaFolder.confirmNothing: There is nothing to move yet. New pictures will be kept in {path}.
mediaFolder.confirmTrash: {trash} of them are earlier copies from Znada's recovery folder (not the library trash). They move too, so nothing that can still be restored is left behind.
mediaFolder.confirmRemovable: That is a removable or network drive. While it is not connected, your library will be unavailable and Znada will not change anything.
mediaFolder.dontClose: Please leave this open until it finishes. Wallpaper changes keep working; the library cannot be edited right now.
mediaFolder.doneBody: {count} files are now in {path}. The old folder is cleared.
mediaFolder.doneNothingBody: Nothing had to move. New pictures will be kept in {path}.
mediaFolder.stoppedBody: Nothing was lost — every file is still in its old place, and the library was not changed.
mediaFolder.failedBody: Nothing was lost — every file is still in its old place, and the library was not changed.
mediaFolder.frozen: Files are being moved — the library cannot be changed right now
mediaFolder.blockedNested: That folder is inside the one Znada uses now, or the other way round. Pick a different place.
mediaFolder.blockedNoSpace: Not enough space on that drive: {needed} needed, {free} free.
mediaFolder.blockedSourceMissing: Znada's current folder is not reachable, so there is nothing to move right now.
mediaFolder.blockedSourceInvalid: The folder Znada uses now is set to a place it must not use, so moving files out of it is not safe. Nothing was changed.
mediaFolder.blockedDestinationMissing: That folder is not there. If it is on a removable or network drive, connect it first.
mediaFolder.blockedSystem: That is a Windows or program folder. Pick a folder of your own.
mediaFolder.blockedProfile: Znada keeps its settings there, so its files cannot go into that folder. Pick a different one.
mediaFolder.blockedDegraded: The library could not be read or written this session, so moving it is not safe. Restart Znada and try again.

smart.updateText: A new version of Znada is downloaded and ready to install. Restart the app to apply the update.
tips: Did you know Znada can hide? Enable Stealth Mode in settings, and the wallpaper will only change when your entire screen is covered by a window.
In Appearance, you can drag and drop images or whole folders directly onto the monitor cards.
Enable Game Mode in settings so Znada pauses wallpaper changes and slideshows while you are playing.
Each monitor can have its own day/night wallpaper pair and its own slideshow. Or you can turn on 'One wallpaper for all monitors'.
Assign a folder in the Library. If you add new photos to that folder, your slideshow will update automatically.
Set the theme schedule to 'By sun', and Znada will switch the light and dark themes exactly at sunrise and sunset.
